info.title: ignixa-matrix
info.description: CLI tool for running FHIR TestScript conformance suites against a server and producing a conformance matrix report.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: ignixa-matrix - FHIR TestScript conformance matrix runner

commands.name: run
commands.description: Run a TestScript suite against a FHIR server and write a per-impl report

options.name: --server
options.description: Base URL of the FHIR server

options.name: --impl
options.description: Implementation name (column label in the matrix)

options.name: --out
options.description: Output path for the report file; --format selects its shape

options.name: --fhir-version
options.description: FHIR version to test against (e.g. '4.0', '4.3', '5.0'). Sets fhirVersion on the Accept header and skips tests not tagged for this version. Omit to run all tests against any server.

options.name: --auth-header
options.description: Authentication header value to apply to every request (for example 'Bearer <token>' or 'Authorization: Bearer <token>')

options.name: --format
options.description: Shape of the --out file: 'fhir' (a Bundle of FHIR TestReport resources, the default) or 'json' (this tool's native per-impl report, which is what 'merge' consumes) [default: Fhir]

commands.name: merge
commands.description: Merge per-impl reports into a conformance matrix run and update the index

options.name: --results
options.description: Directory containing per-impl report JSON files

options.name: --out
options.description: Output directory for runs/ and index.json
